rows.title: Xiao-I Renews Partnership With Global Insurer To Expand AI-Driven Customer Service
rows.description: (RTTNews) - Xiao-I Corp. (AIXI), a global cognitive intelligence solution, Friday announced that it has renewed its strategic partnership with a multinational life insurance provider to continue deploying its enterprise-grade conversational AI platform, iBot Pro.

rows.title: Xiao-I, AIA China Deepen AI Partnership With Approx. 4 Mln RMB Contract, Stock Up
rows.description: (RTTNews) - Xiao-I Corp. (AIXI), an enterprise in AI, Tuesday announced that it has extended its collaboration with insurance giant AIA China through a one-year agreement worth 3 to 4 million RMB.

rows.title: Xiao-I, TF International Partner To Advance AI In Finance, Stock Down
rows.description: (RTTNews) - Xiao-I Corp. (AIXI), an artificial intelligence company, Wednesday announced a global strategic partnership with TF International Securities Group Limited, a Hong Kong-based financial institution under Hubei Hongtai Group and Tianfeng Securities.
